name: Moll del 75
summary: Allen Premium Outlets is a popular outlet shopping destination in North Dallas, offering designer and name-brand merchandise at discounted prices. Located along the thriving Central Expressway corridor in Allen, Texas, the center serves affluent suburban shoppers seeking value on quality brands.
demographics: The Allen Premium Outlets attracts a diverse mix of value-conscious shoppers from the affluent Dallas-Fort Worth suburbs, particularly families and young professionals from Allen, Plano, and McKinney with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The trade area serves a predominantly educated demographic seeking designer brands at discounted prices, with strong representation from Asian and Hispanic households reflective of the region's diversity. Shopping patterns indicate weekend-heavy traffic with visitors willing to drive 30-45 minutes for outlet deals, combining shopping trips with dining experiences at nearby restaurants along the Central Expressway corridor.
description: Allen Premium Outlets, located at 820 West Stacy Road in Allen, Texas, is a premier outlet shopping destination serving the thriving North Dallas suburbs. As part of the Premium Outlets collection, this center offers shoppers access to designer and name-brand merchandise at exceptional values, making it a popular destination for savvy consumers throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The center's strategic location along the rapidly growing Central Expressway corridor positions it at the heart of one of Texas's most affluent and fastest-growing regions, with easy access from major thoroughfares. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, the outlet center provides a convenient shopping experience for both local residents and visitors exploring the Allen area. The center has earned a strong reputation among shoppers, reflected in its impressive 4.8-star rating, demonstrating its commitment to providing quality retail experiences and value-driven shopping opportunities in a well-maintained outlet environment.
